items.title: Pushouts exist in the category of filtered objects and a strict map stays strict
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the category of filtered objects of an abelian category admits pushouts, constructed as the cokernel of the difference of the two given maps, and that the induced map from the second object is strict whenever the first given map is (statement lines 5115-5128). The proof is a complete argument: the pushout is exhibited as a cokernel, whose existence is supplied by a named lemma, and identified through a named example (proof lines 5130-5134); the filtration step of the pushout is described as an image and the preimage along the induced map is computed to be the displayed sum, which is strictness (proof lines 5135-5141). The non-formal content is the computation of the filtration step of the pushout. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
